coder_notes: GBM (recurrent Cohort 2, newly diagnosed MGMT-unmethylated Cohort 3) plus melanoma brain metastases (Cohort 1): coded basket_gbm_eligible (multi-cancer); could alternatively be read as gbm_only for GBM cohorts. Crizanlizumab role differs: monotherapy in Cohort 3 and first 3 patients of Cohorts 1-2 (coded experimental_monotherapy); experimental_combination with nivolumab for subsequent Cohort 1-2 patients. Regimen coded combination since nivolumab combination arms exist; Cohort 3 is monotherapy (TTFields allowed per local standard). Cohort 1 arm has no linked interventions in registry but description gives crizanlizumab +/- nivolumab. Tumour PK yes: CSF and tissue samples for PK stated in description (registered PK outcome is plasma only). BRAF mentioned only as melanoma treatment history, not listed.
